decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already fully records that publication requires the images and internal links to be added, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that the required images must be added before publication.
The publication prerequisite for internal links does not change the selected blog topics or topic-revision constraints.
The conditional authorization to publish does not change the required article type, inclusion in the trial, or article count.
Requiring internal links before publication does not alter the blog keyword-selection rules.
The source decision concerns publication prerequisites for a blog and does not change the keyword research report or its required data.
The blog publication condition does not change the scope or contents of the SEO plan deliverable.
